main_body: A round leafy bush/canopy blob (about 46x46 px) made of green leaf clumps with three small brown twig patches; no trunk or visible front face
top_band: none: the column reads as a uniform mottled green canopy from the top row to the bottom; no distinct lighter horizontal top band followed by a front face
evidence: The whole sprite is a flat, roughly circular leaf mass seen as a top-down plan. There is no separate top surface above a front face, no trunk and no underside or shaded lower canopy that would give a south face. Light and dark leaf clumps are scattered evenly across the whole disc, so there is no top-to-front structure. Compared with the references, which show a canopy over a trunk with a shaded underside, this lacks the front volume.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 green steps (a bright lime highlight, light, mid, dark and a deep teal-green edge) in leaf clumps, and the outline is a dark teal-green tone that leans toward the leaves rather than black. There are no large flat fills, and the leaf-pixel noise gives some texture. It is more uniform and noisier than the references, which have clear clump forms with highlighted tops and deeper shadowed undersides, and it has no trunk or volume structure. Brown twig patches are tiny. Density per tile is decent but the clump definition is weaker than the reference, so it reads slightly thinner and flatter.
